version_policy: Pinned upstream commit; no release or installed package version asserted.

notices: ISC: Copyright (c) 2026 Lucide Icons and Contributors
MIT for listed Feather derivatives: Copyright (c) 2013-present Cole Bemis

scope: Eleven statically vendored SVGs for the authorized header/navigation controls only.

runtime.integration: Dedicated symbols in the existing index.html sprite, local fragment <use>; official generator carries them and license notice to portable HTML.

presentation_adaptation.note: CSS presentation adaptation only. Keep symbol stroke inherited from each shell SVG, do not fix it at 2 inside a symbol.

excluded.apple_assets: No Apple asset, SF Symbol or font file distributed. System font stack only.
excluded.controller_owned_indicators: Existing two-line CSS menu glyph, rail glyph, disclosure arrows and state transformations are not Lucide and remain unchanged.
excluded.internal_modules: No SVG replacement in Execution Board, checklist or other internal-module controls.

security_review.method: Parse all raw SVGs; strict element/attribute allowlists; reject external URLs, event attributes, scripts, foreignObject, entities, non-SVG namespaces and control characters.
security_review.license_coverage: Full original repository LICENSE retained without edits; per-icon ISC/MIT applicability indexed below.
